grouping.known_component_basis: All tracks and excerpts within a dialogue are connected; no cross-dialogue participant equivalence is discoverable in the pinned card/tree/EAF evidence.
grouping.limitation: Whole-dialogue separation is established. It does not certify independence of unknown recurring speakers or invent equivalence from repeated demographics. Any subsequently discovered connected participants must remain on one side before acceptance.

P1.reason: All required candidates are materialized; the request clip still lacks independent corroboration of its primary request. Core support is not full audible-reference acceptance or a production freeze. No human-only or global-identity prerequisite is imposed.

P2.reason: All nine mixed-input candidates are materialized. Specific important numbers, clauses, speaker reactions or boundary evidence remain unresolved as detailed below; ASR omissions are not source-failure findings. No cell or weight substitution.

P3.reason: All six complete explanation candidates are materialized. Three have independent support for their core checkpoints; three retain specific content/uncertainty/endpoint questions. No automatic full-fidelity certification or production freeze is claimed.

pre_result_selection.checkpoints: Source EAF evidence IDs, essential meanings, allowed semantic paraphrases and 0/+2/+5/+10/+15 s observations selected before app results; EAF end times are provisional, not certified phonetic ends.
pre_result_selection.paraphrase_policy: Checkpoint paraphrases are illustrative semantic alternatives, not a string whitelist or a unique model Korean translation. Accept any accurate Korean expression preserving the stated questions, negation, conditions, attribution and approximate numbers.

public_example_preselection.content_basis: Generic electricity-cost agreement question; no names, exact locations or personal identifiers in selected EAF row.
public_example_preselection.privacy_review: EAF semantic screen found no concrete sensitive disclosure; actual audible-content review remains pending.
public_example_preselection.publication_authorization: separate and pending; not automatic approval to upload audio/transcript/translation/video
public_example_preselection.license_conditions: CC BY-NC 4.0 credit/license/pinned-source/modification notice; no corpus-to-MIT relicensing

review.source_semantics: Original Japanese EAF passages and all closure-added context reviewed; not just manifest shapes.
review.source_audio: All selected full mixed WAVs decoded and source/sample-bound crops examined by signal statistics; exact PCM binding is tested by materialization.
review.independent_asr: Actually executed sherpa_onnx 1.13.8 / pinned ReazonSpeech-k2-v2, CPU 2 threads, no text hints, all 21 unchanged WAVs. Corrected bounded review contains 87 views of at most 20 seconds with 2-second overlaps. Raw views and exact sample offsets are retained locally; midpoint token ownership deduplicates comparison only.
review.annotation_uncertainty: Literal uncertainty/laughter markers retained locally. Full EAF includes both speakers; no product ASR replacement.
review.mixed_policy: P1/P2/P3 use the original mixed WAV; all source gaps and overlapping speakers remain. No individual-track leakage-free or role-isolation claim.

freeze_gates: Resolve each specifically held audible-reference or crop-boundary question using suitable source/audio evidence. Automatic source-semantic/waveform/independent-ASR evidence can support R2 within its declared limits; human listening is not a mandatory gate and CER is not an acceptance threshold.
Preserve whole-dialogue and all discoverable known connected-participant grouping; unknown recurring participants are not independently certified.
External-provider compatibility must be cleared separately for each intended actual route/account before transmission.
Source-bearing public examples require publication authorization, CC conditions and content/privacy review; preselection is not publication approval.
Global #16 freeze remains blocked by unavailable ASCEND T1 parents; do not replace data or redistribute weights.

checks_exercised: All selected original file and decoded PCM hashes
Native WAV decoding, not a fixed 44-byte header assumption
Every crop PCM and rendered WAV hash and exact decode roundtrip
Whole-dialogue and all recorded known-component separation
Half-open source intervals do not overlap
Both EAF speakers retained, no partial original annotation at crop edges
Exact source-to-playback offsets, original gaps and overlaps; zero added silence, resampling, splicing or role masking
All fixed main counts and development minima; no redistributed weights
materialization.metadata_evolution: The actual materialization snapshot predates independent ASR review. Later public review/status additions do not change candidate playback, original-human-EAF references or checkpoints.

initial_asr_attempt.interpretation: Retained out-of-contract long-view attempt, not evidence of source omission. Severe long-clip ASR collapse motivated the bounded same-audio diagnostic, not easier replacement playback.

bounded_independent_asr.comparison_policy: Inspect raw window text against original EAF and semantic checkpoints, not CER thresholds. Approximate ASR-token timing is not certified acoustic timing. Uncorroborated content is unresolved, not established inaudibility or upstream error.

execution_evidence.focused_tests: tests/test_prepare_ingcrowd.py added with synthetic inputs; not run by worker. Director owns integrated verification.
execution_evidence.historical_corpus: No historical corpus bytes were used as replacement material or edited.

candidate_review_observations.level: Original-human-EAF semantic inspection plus actual mixed-WAV signal/sample inspection and no-hints bounded independent ASR. Not actual listening, forced-alignment validation, or complete acoustic-fidelity certification.

observations.observation: Independent ASR corroborates the complete recent-electricity-price question. Boundary 50ms RMS is -53.14/-67.46 dBFS. No concrete sensitive disclosure found in the selected source row; public-example authorization remains separate.
ASR recognizes the interlocutor's follow-up question but not the primary attention request. This is noncorroboration, not proof the request is inaudible. Trailing EAF shoulder is 90ms.
Independent ASR corroborates the topic change and appliance-selection preference question; fillers and some second-speaker reactions are omitted. Boundary 50ms RMS is -64.13/-61.12 dBFS.

Bounded ASR recovers family-home answer and expensive/crowded-holiday reasoning, but not the opening holiday question. Both source speakers and all original overlaps remain, rather than dropping unrecognized reactions.
ASR supports theme-park/children context, distinct family preferences and meals together, but parts of the grandparents hypothetical and short question/answer clauses are not fully corroborated.

ASR supports approximate 1000/500/1500-yen amounts and monthly cost complaint; brief agreement clauses remain noncorroborated. Original trailing EAF shoulder is 80ms, with last-50ms RMS -64.19 dBFS; this is a signal observation, not phonetic endpoint proof.

Bounded ASR supports exercise for enjoyment and possible later-life mobility benefits; the initial not-particularly-health-conscious response and some clauses are omitted. 101.91s retains the complete explanation rather than cutting to the approximate 90s work target.

The initial long-view collapse is substantially repaired by bounded diagnostics: dress-change sequence, four-hour complaint and high-note ending reappear. The contrasting two-to-three-hour preference remains noncorroborated; no source failure is inferred.

ASR supports adding Japanese-history tutoring and self-study, but does not reliably recover the monthly-versus-summer-course correction or all assessment details. Leading 50ms RMS -35.90 dBFS leaves an unannotated onset/tail question despite a 250ms EAF shoulder. Duration 98.585s keeps the connected exchange.

Bounded ASR recovers summer household congestion and housing-cost contrast after initial collapse, but misrecognizes homework and omits the six-thousand-something-yen amount and competition conclusion. Original EAF shoulders are 65/45ms.

ASR supports high-feature-appliance concerns and this-year/next-year price-model contrast, but not the 2027 correction. EAF a183 retains an uncertainty marker; the leading EAF shoulder is only 12ms, though first-50ms RMS is -56.59 dBFS.

ASR supports practical AI translation/search use and remaining human-language advantages. It does not fully corroborate the occasional-falsehood qualifier or service name; original reference is unchanged.

Independent ASR corroborates gym-start enthusiasm, proper-workout pressure, special-trip burden, about one month attendance versus one-and-a-half years paying, and eventual cancellation. Source full-scale samples are recorded, not silently repaired.
Independent ASR corroborates pandemic online ceremonies, uncertainty about current continuation and perceived family-only funeral trend. Boundary 50ms RMS is -64.22/-67.12 dBFS.

ASR supports same-department correction, five possible versus four eligible days, best-result selection and more chances. Politics/economics is rendered with homophonic wrong words; source EAF supplies the subject. Last-50ms RMS -37.41 dBFS leaves the trailing reaction/endpoint unresolved.

ASR supports temporary wireless service, one-to-two-week gap, smartphone/computer contrast and wired-service conclusion, but omits the approximate monthly price increase and some interlocutor statements. EAF a12 remains uncertain.

Bounded diagnostics recover fifth-year failure, persistent heat, service diagnosis and just-expired-warranty exception, unlike the initial near-empty long view. The first summer-failure statement and twenty-degree setting remain uncorroborated; EAF a3 remains uncertain.

Independent ASR corroborates the AI-use question, reported distinction between using AI and delegating work to it, and the speaker's difficulty even at the first stage. Some reactions/fillers are omitted.
Independent ASR corroborates the complete dream-cause question. Boundary 50ms RMS is -67.33/-61.26 dBFS. Dialogue10 is development-only, not an independent-speaker claim.
ASR supports recurring university dreams, age correction, dream-versus-real graduate study and employment worries, but omits the oversleeping/missed-class causal clause.

ASR supports pasture care, milking and deeper self-directed study without promised enrollment. Morning/evening and dry-period terms are garbled and EAF a190 includes uncertainty; the original human reference is not overwritten.

reproduction.download_method: Fetch each sources[].wav_url/eaf_url and source.card_url as pinned direct public downloads to matching retained paths, and verify SHA256; no dataset loader, provider or account settings.
reproduction.playback_format: mono PCM16 WAV 16000 Hz, exact original mixed-track sample crop; R6 owns app routing and any separately pinned conversion.
reproduction.local_output: playback WAVs, original-human-EAF references with literal quotes/checkpoints and materialization evidence under .data/r2/ingcrowd/
